name: Enterprise / Public Company
description: Post-IPO or mature private. 500+ employees. Sustaining and optimizing at scale.
org_structure: Deep hierarchy. Multiple layers (IC → Manager → Director → VP → SVP → EVP → C-suite). Matrix or business-unit structure.
decision_making: Structured governance. Committees for key decisions. RACI frameworks. Quarterly business reviews.
hiring: Formal hiring process. Multiple interview rounds. Panel decisions. Deep specialist roles. Internal mobility programs.
process_maturity: Mature processes. SOPs for everything. Change management. Toll gates for releases. Compliance-driven controls.
compensation: Top-of-market cash + RSUs (not options). Annual bonuses (target 10-30%). Extensive benefits. Perennial performance management.
